zh.title: 特斯拉这是准备去火星飙车？赛博皮卡越野，Roadster 负责起飞
zh.excerpt: 推进、下压力与倒挂演示把赛车游戏般的想象带进现实。发布会负责点燃好奇，真正的交付还要靠工程。
zh.content:
极品飞车、氮气加速、遥遥领先。看完今天的特斯拉 Roadster 发布会，我脑子里先蹦出了这几个词。

再看那辆离开地面的白色跑车，我已经开始给火星车队分工：赛博皮卡负责越野，Roadster 负责起飞。

![特斯拉这是准备去火星飙车？赛博皮卡越野，Roadster 负责起飞。](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/01-racing-on-mars.png)

## 01｜游戏里的加速键，这次装进了现实

小时候玩赛车游戏，总想把加速条攒满，再找条直道一口气按下去。这一次，工程师把类似的画面搬进了现实。

![极品飞车的加速键，这次装进了现实。](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/02-boost-button.png)

当然，“氮气加速”只是我的游戏梗。报道中的冷气推进系统使用高压空气，向外喷出空气，为车辆提供额外推力。把它理解为工程方案，比把它说成魔法更有意思。

## 02｜同叫 Roadster，本领要看版本

先看清配置，再开始许愿。

据发布会报道，Roadster 有性能版、推力版和火箭版：基础车型、追加推进能力的版本，以及单座、仅限邀请的特殊火箭版，能力各有不同。

![同叫 Roadster，本领要看版本。](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/03-different-versions.png)

舞台上的飞行演示，也不能直接当成每一台量产车的日常道路功能。原来，童年外挂也得先看版本。

## 03｜倒挂停车，是概念脑洞也是工程问题

另一个让我忍不住笑的画面，是倒挂。买车除了刷火箭、送飞机，还送蜘蛛侠套装？以后停车场写“车位已满”，我是不是还得抬头看一眼？

![买车还送蜘蛛侠套装？我先抬头找个停车位。](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/04-ceiling-parking.png)

这张海报是我的概念脑洞。现实里的吸附需要适合的接触面、密封条件和持续工作的系统，不能把艺术画面当成新闻现场或已经开放的功能。

## 04｜它没有让重力消失，而是让空气帮忙

可以把车底想成一个持续抽气的大吸盘：风扇把底部空气抽走，密封结构减少漏气，车底气压降低，外部空气压力便把它压向接触面。

![它没有让重力消失，它让空气来帮忙。](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/05-air-pressure.png)

因此，车辆即使不向前行驶，也能获得附着力。这个解释没有让画面变得不酷，反而让我更想知道控制、密封和安全系统怎样一起工作。

## 05｜最酷的瞬间，是“这也行？”有了实物

风扇下压力并非今天才出现。McMurtry 此前已在专门装置上演示静止倒挂。

![最酷的瞬间，是“这也行？”终于有了实物。](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/06-seeing-possible.png)

知道前人的尝试，并不妨碍我兴奋。一个“这也行？”的念头，背后要经过设计、控制和反复试验。吸引我的，是想象终于有了一个能动的实物。

## 06｜初代真的上过太空，这一代又让想象加速

2018 年，一辆初代 Roadster 真的搭乘猎鹰重型火箭进入了太空。

![初代已经上过太空，这一代让想象继续加速。](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/07-roadster-in-space.png)

这一代又把跑车与航天工程放在一起，难怪人会开始联想。至于去火星飙车，先当作我的科幻脑洞：火星大气稀薄，地球上的吸附方案不能原样照搬。

## 07｜发布会点燃想象，交付才能把它带进生活

兴奋之外，我也惦记着交付。据发布会报道，马斯克给出的计划是 2028 年进入生产。

![发布会点燃想象，交付才能把想象带进生活。](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/08-reveal-and-reality.png)

舞台上令人惊叹的演示，离长期、稳定、安全地使用还有工程工作要完成。计划也可能变化。发布会最擅长点燃想象，而我真正期待的是它最终能把多少想象带进真实生活。

## 08｜对未来的好奇，不用先付定金

我不急着问自己买不买。很久没有一场汽车发布会，让我像小时候看科幻电影一样，觉得未来还有这么多好玩的东西。

![不买也可以兴奋。对未来的好奇，不用付定金。](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/09-curiosity-no-deposit.png)

暂时不下单，也可以为一次技术尝试高兴。对未来的好奇，毕竟不用先付定金。

本期采用[虾子曰艺术风格图鉴](https://style-atlas.wonderelian.com/)推荐的 **Rinpa／琳派风格**。银箔底、装饰性曲线与留白，把工业科幻放进更有东方节奏的画面里。海报均为 AI 艺术演绎；火星、倒挂停车等画面包含概念想象，并非新闻现场照片。

### 参考资料

- [腾讯科技：《马斯克造了一辆来自 2077 年的“科幻超跑”，它会飞》](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/x-9X8mvm78LDqKuYkFSovA)
- [Tesla Roadster 预订页面](https://www.tesla.com/roadster/reserve)
- [McMurtry：静止倒挂演示说明](https://mcmurtry.com/upside-down-driving/)
- [NASA：猎鹰重型火箭首次飞行五周年](https://www.nasa.gov/history/5-years-ago-first-flight-of-the-falcon-heavy-rocket/)
- [NASA：火星风流动资料](https://science.nasa.gov/resource/wind-flow-on-mars/)

以上资料于 2026 年 10 月 16 日核对。发布会版本、生产计划与能力仍可能调整。

en.label: Field Notes
en.title: Is Tesla Preparing to Race on Mars? Cybertruck Explores, Roadster Takes Off
en.excerpt: Propulsion, fan downforce, and an upside-down demonstration bring racing-game imagination into reality. A reveal sparks curiosity; engineering still has to deliver.
en.content:
Need for Speed, boost engaged, way out in front—those were the first phrases that came to mind while I watched the new Tesla Roadster presentation.

Then I saw the white sports car leave the ground and began assigning jobs to an imaginary Mars fleet: Cybertruck handles the terrain; Roadster handles takeoff.

![Racing on Mars? Cybertruck explores. Roadster takes off. The original poster is bilingual.](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/01-racing-on-mars.png)

## 01｜The Boost Button from a Game Entered Reality

As a child playing racing games, I would save the entire boost meter and wait for a straight road before pressing it all at once. This presentation brought a similar image into the physical world.

![The boost button from a racing game just entered reality. The original poster is bilingual.](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/02-boost-button.png)

“Nitrous boost” is only my gaming joke. The cold-gas propulsion system described in reports uses compressed air expelled from the vehicle to create additional thrust. Understanding it as an engineering system is more interesting than calling it magic.

## 02｜The Same Roadster Name Covers Different Capabilities

First understand the configuration; then begin wishing.

According to reports from the presentation, the Roadster was described in Performance, Thruster, and Rocket forms: a base performance car, a version with added propulsion capability, and a special single-seat, invitation-only Rocket version.

![The same Roadster name covers different capabilities. The original poster is bilingual.](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/03-different-versions.png)

A flight demonstration onstage should not be treated as an everyday road feature on every production car. Even the childhood cheat code depends on the version.

## 03｜Ceiling Parking Is Both a Joke and an Engineering Problem

Another image made me laugh: an upside-down car. Does the purchase include a Spider-Man suit? When a parking garage says “full,” will I have to look at the ceiling?

![Does it come with a Spider-Man suit? Let me check the ceiling for parking. The original poster is bilingual.](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/04-ceiling-parking.png)

The poster is a concept from my imagination. Real adhesion requires an appropriate surface, a seal, and a continuously operating system. The artwork is not a news photograph or proof of an available feature.

## 04｜Gravity Is Still There; Air Pressure Lends a Hand

Imagine the underside of the car as a large suction cup that keeps drawing air out. Fans remove air from below, a skirt or seal limits leakage, and the lower pressure beneath the vehicle lets the surrounding atmosphere press it against the surface.

![Gravity is still here. Air pressure lends a hand. The original poster is bilingual.](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/05-air-pressure.png)

This can create adhesion even when the car is not moving forward. The explanation does not make the image less exciting. It makes me more curious about how control, sealing, and safety would have to work together.

## 05｜The Coolest Moment Is Seeing “Could That Work?” Become Physical

Fan-generated downforce is not new. McMurtry previously demonstrated a purpose-built vehicle holding itself upside down while stationary.

![The coolest moment is seeing “Could that work?” become real. The original poster is bilingual.](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/06-seeing-possible.png)

Knowing the history does not reduce my excitement. A thought like “could that work?” still has to pass through design, control, and repeated testing. What draws me in is seeing imagination become a moving object.

## 06｜The First Roadster Went to Space; This One Accelerates the Imagination

In 2018, an original Roadster actually traveled into space aboard the first Falcon Heavy launch.

![The first Roadster went to space. This one keeps the imagination accelerating. The original poster is bilingual.](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/07-roadster-in-space.png)

Placing a sports car and aerospace engineering in the same story again naturally invites more speculation. Racing on Mars remains my science-fiction idea: Mars has a thin atmosphere, so an air-pressure adhesion system designed for Earth cannot simply be copied there.

## 07｜A Reveal Sparks Imagination; Delivery Brings It into Life

Alongside the excitement, I keep thinking about delivery. Reports from the event say Elon Musk presented a plan to enter production in 2028.

![A reveal sparks imagination. Delivery brings it into real life. The original poster is bilingual.](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/08-reveal-and-reality.png)

A spectacular demonstration is still separated from long-term, stable, safe use by substantial engineering work. Plans can also change. A reveal is good at igniting imagination; what I want to see is how much of that imagination eventually enters ordinary life.

## 08｜Curiosity About the Future Requires No Deposit

I am not rushing to ask whether I would buy one. It has been a long time since a car presentation made me feel like a child watching science fiction, convinced that the future still contains so many entertaining possibilities.

![You can feel the excitement without buying. Curiosity requires no deposit. The original poster is bilingual.](/assets/notes/2026-10-16-tesla-roadster/09-curiosity-no-deposit.png)

I can celebrate a technical attempt without placing an order. Curiosity about the future, after all, requires no deposit.

This series uses the **Rinpa style** recommended by [Xiazi Style Atlas](https://style-atlas.wonderelian.com/). Silver-leaf backgrounds, decorative curves, and open space place industrial science fiction inside an East Asian visual rhythm. All posters are AI-made artistic interpretations. Mars, ceiling parking, and other scenes contain conceptual imagination and are not photographs from the event.

### Sources

- [Tencent Technology: “Musk built a science-fiction supercar from 2077—and it flies”](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/x-9X8mvm78LDqKuYkFSovA)

These sources were checked on October 16, 2026. Versions, production schedules, and capabilities described at an event may change.
